headline: Citizens Reiterates Buy Rating on Ares Management on Strong Deployment Outlook
summary: Citizens reiterated its stock rating on Ares Management, highlighting a strong capital deployment outlook for the alternative asset manager.
why: Analyst ratings and outlook updates on alternative asset managers influence institutional capital allocation and near-term equity valuations.

impacts.name: Ares Management
impacts.why: Citizens reiterated its rating based on capital deployment outlook.
